review_autonomy.rationale: Separate owner grant and authority-validator transition; future payload merge requires owner authorization.

requested_decision: Review the governed activation of the already approved frozen twelve-target package. After lead, CI and readiness, authorize the exact PR payload for merge commit with no admin bypass. No merge authority is inferred from the task grant.
non_negotiable_requirements: Frozen package, historical content/Ei/goal decisions and unrelated holds preserved.
Separate immutable integration grant; distinct post-authorization activation commit containing exact grant, pending holds, pins, actual outline semantics and frozen records.
Historical pending, authorized pending and fully released states; no scoped-action or partial-release bypass.
No lesson output before governed main transition plus CI; no future payload merge authority manufactured.

core_requirement_checklist.requirement: Student output unchanged and continuation named

rendered_output.reason: No student copy or visual assets change. Complete 41-PDF rendered review belongs to the gated production continuation.

stop_conditions: Unresolved core/specification finding or failed exact-head CI
Changed frozen target, semantic, authorization, activation or historical evidence
Premature lesson production or unreviewed release of independent teaching/book/chapter holds
review_questions: Does the separate grant faithfully record the owner's verbatim statement and bounded subsequent production scope?
Do all three lifecycle states and their negative mutations fail closed across currentness and durable validators?
Does committed activation prove exact evidence, pending holds/pins, actual outline semantics and frozen content, with all releases naming the same commit?
Are the five remaining holds and main/CI-before-production condition preserved?
Is the reviewed exact payload authorized for the normal merge-commit integration lane without admin bypass?
comment_prompt: Comment on the complete packet with findings and exact evidence. The agent records each disposition; ambiguous/conflicting authority requires targeted follow-up. A content/implementation PASS is not payload merge authorization.
